summary: Verified 3 minor polish fixes from iteration_4: (1) unused getStaffEmails import removed from app/actions/requests.ts, (2) Resend fetch now has signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000), (3) Emergent proxy fetch also has signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000). Ran tsc --noEmit (exit 0, no errors) and next build (exit 0, 20 routes generated including all target routes). AbortSignal.timeout compiles cleanly with current tsconfig (target ES2017 + lib esnext covers ES2022 AbortSignal.timeout types) and runs natively in Node 20.20.2 — no polyfill involved.
critical_code_review_comments: tsconfig target is ES2017 but lib includes 'esnext' — AbortSignal.timeout types resolve fine; however for clarity/future-proofing, bumping target to ES2022 would be more idiomatic (not blocking, Node 20+ runtime supports it natively).

Build log shows repeated Supabase deprecation warning: 'Node.js 20 and below are deprecated... please upgrade to Node.js 22 or later' — not blocking current iteration but worth tracking for a near-term runtime upgrade.
